This stem is found chiefly in mild temperate climates, especially in freshwater banks and shores, and is best known in south-eastern Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains very hard to find.

The fresh stalk is crushed into a poultice for a fracture that has already been properly set. Applied to the injured area, it doubles the natural rate at which the bone knits. Freshness is essential: the stalk loses its healing properties within a few hours of harvesting. The poultice does not set displaced bones by itself.
